producer_report.summary: I set athena.toml's [capabilities.study] to repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate" and repo_ref = "main", replacing the commented example. I added a comment saying this is the first study instance and that Athena pins the ref to a commit before dispatch. I also added a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] > Added. Clippy and fmt --check pass. cargo test --locked fails: two athena-core run_pin_tests break because their fixture inserts repo keys into the live athena.toml, which now produces a duplicate key. Fixing that requires editing crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs, which the acceptance criteria do not allow, so I stopped and left the test file alone. The change needs that test-fixture fix, or a scope decision, before it can land.

checks_run.note: Failed: 31 passed, 2 failed in athena-core run_pin_tests. Both failures come from the new athena.toml values: config() in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs inserts repo_url/repo_ref right after the [capabilities.study] header, so the file now has a duplicate key (TOML parse error at line 88, 'duplicate key'). The second test also expects no repo_url in the base config.
Finished with no warnings or errors.

open_issues: cargo test --locked FAILS (2 tests in athena-core run_pin_tests). Acceptance criterion 4 is not met. The fix belongs in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs: config() must not depend on the live [capabilities.study] repo keys, for example by stripping repo_url/repo_ref lines from the included athena.toml before inserting the test values, and the 'without a repo' test must use a config with the keys removed. That file is outside the deliverables and criterion 3 allows no other file changes, so I did not touch it. The job needs either the scope widened to include that test file or a decision to hold the firstmate config until that fix lands.
No commit was made; the edits are uncommitted in the working directory.
The M1 study is still not run, as the request scoped it.
mistakes: I edited athena.toml before checking which tests read it. I should have grepped for include_str!(athena.toml) first, which would have shown that the change breaks run_pin_tests.rs and that acceptance criterion 4 cannot pass without editing a file the criteria exclude.

The new CHANGELOG line says the configuration 'replaces the commented example'. That is accurate, but the older entry above it still says the keys were added as a commented example. I left the historical entry as is.
learnings: crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs includes athena.toml with include_str! and its config(true/false) helper inserts repo_url/repo_ref directly under the [capabilities.study] header. Any live repo_url in that section breaks both tests.
The [capabilities.study] comment block (athena.toml lines 83-84) already says Athena resolves the ref to a commit before dispatch.
Athena's changelog [Unreleased] section has an Added list; the new entry was added at its top.
desires: A way to run cargo with the Athena-set CARGO_TARGET_DIR; I used the default target directory outside the snapshot.
Knowledge of which tests read the live athena.toml before editing it (a grep for include_str!("../../../athena.toml") would have shown run_pin_tests.rs).
